news_risk: No adverse regulatory action, penalty order or negative press located. The only litigation trail is (a) the company acting as claimant in a commercial suit against a supplier/contractor, and (b) a recurring pattern of GST/commercial-tax writ petitions (2022 Madras HC, 2025-26 Madras HC, 2026 Calcutta HC). These are tax-assessment disputes, not findings of fraud; no adjudicated penalty against the company was found in public records. Note: DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable during this check (connection refused), so news coverage could not be exhaustively swept — negative-news coverage is therefore 'not found', not 'confirmed absent'.
rf_supply: No evidence found. No Indian Kanoon judgment links the company to Russia/CIS; no public record of Russian or CIS contracts, shipments or counterparties located. Company website lists project references only in India (JSW Steel, Tata Steel, Heidelberg Cement, Coastal Gujarat Power, NPCIL Tarapur) and one overseas reference in the Philippines (Balingasag 3x55 MW coal handling plant) — no Russia/CIS reference. Status: no trace of RF/CIS supply found in public sources.
note: Sanctions: OpenSanctions consolidated screening (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS and others; data current as of 2026-11-27) returned 'No matching entities were found' for 'Macmet'.
